manifest.name: dsh-skill-mcp-panel
manifest.description: A Skill list and MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness, mounted as a sidebar panel and themed entirely from the host's own design tokens.
manifest.author: re-ITRT

bundle.text:
# dsh-skill-mcp-panel bundle patch.
#
# A profile selects this bundle from `dsh.profile.bundles`; this patch inserts
# the package's Node half into the profile's layer stack. The browser half is
# composed separately from the same package's `dsh.client` declaration, so one
# row here mounts both halves.
- insert:
    - id: skill-mcp-panel
      name: 'dsh-skill-mcp-panel'

readme.text:
> A Skill list and MCP server manager for **DeepSeek Harness**, mounted as a
> sidebar panel and themed entirely from the host's own design tokens.

[](./LICENSE)
[](#tests)
[](#layout)

[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md)

One sidebar entry — **技能与 MCP** — opens a full page with two dense lists: every
Agent skill this deployment serves, and every configured MCP server. Each row is a
single line: name, a short description, a switch, and a **详情** toggle that
expands in place. MCP rows can also be edited, created, and deleted, and both
lists can reveal the directory the thing lives in.

The page carries no theme code. Every colour, radius, font, and focus ring comes
from the host's own `--dsw-*` tokens, and its type follows the host's own font
size, so it tracks the deployment theme (light, dark, or a third-party theme) and
the Settings → Appearance → **Font size** setting automatically.

`dsh-client-ui-layout` projects the content font size onto `body` as an inline
variable and derives a delta from it:

```css
--dsh-content-font-size: 14px;                      /* 12–17, the user's setting */
--dsh-content-font-delta: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size, 14px) - 14px);
```

Every size on this page is expressed the way the conversation surfaces express
theirs — `<base>px + var(--smp-delta)` — where `--smp-delta` aliases
`--dsh-content-font-delta`. Nothing is a fixed pixel size, and a test asserts
that, so the panel grows and shrinks with the setting exactly as the transcript
beside it does.

The catalog visible to the current session composition, so project- and
preset-scoped skills appear beside bundled ones.

| Control | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Name | the `/name` identifier, plus its discovery source, plus a policy tag **only when the policy is not the default** |
| Description | clamped to one line; the full text stays in the tooltip |
| Switch | enables or disables the skill |
| 详情 | provider, source, path, the invocation policy spelled out, the full body, and 打开目录 / 删除 |

A skill has two independent invocation flags, both on by default:

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `modelInvocable` | the skill is in the **model's** catalog, so the Agent may load it on its own |
| `userInvocable` | the skill is in the composer's **`/` menu**, so you can invoke it by typing `/name` |

Because both are on for almost every skill, tagging them everywhere says nothing.
The row tags only the surprising cases, and the detail panel spells the policy out
in a sentence instead of leaving two words to interpret.

Switching a skill off is maintained by this plugin, not by editing files. DSH has
no per-skill switch: a skill exists because a provider lists it, and each provider
decides its own invocation policy — the shipped Office provider **hard-codes both
flags and ignores frontmatter**, so no file edit could ever disable those skills.

The lever that works for every provider is the registry's own duplicate rule:
within a layer, the candidate with the lowest `rank` wins the name. This plugin
therefore registers one provider that re-declares each switched-off skill with
`rank: 0` and `invocation: { modelInvocable: false, userInvocable: false }`. That
removes it from the model catalog and the human `/` menu while keeping it visible
here — with its original description, provider, and body — so it can be switched
back on.

The set lives in one JSON file, `<DSH home>/storages/skill-mcp-panel.json`, and
every change invalidates the registry's catalog cache.

**删除** really removes the file — it is not another way of switching off. A
directory bundle is the whole `<root>/<name>/` directory, so its references and
scripts go with it; anything else is the single file. The confirmation says which
of the two removal modes applies *before* anything happens.

| The skill comes from | Mode | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| the user — `project-dsh`, `project-agents`, `user-dsh`, `user-agents`, `custom` | **permanent** | the file is deleted outright; nothing is kept |
| the deployment — `bundled` and anything else | **parked** | the file leaves its root but is moved to the trash and listed under **已删除**, where **恢复** puts it back |

The split follows the registry's own `source` bucket, which is what says who owns
the file. Your own skills are yours to delete, so they are deleted. A shipped skill
is different: removing one destroys a file an upgrade owns and an install would
silently restore, and the switch cannot disable the Office skills at all. Parking
those keeps the one lever that does work reversible.

A parked skill goes to `<DSH home>/storages/skill-mcp-panel.trash/<id>/` with a
`manifest.json` naming its original path. Restoring refuses to overwrite a path
that has since reappeared, and a trash id is validated as a single path segment,
so nothing outside the trash can be addressed.

Removal is always two steps: the action row is replaced by a confirmation naming
the skill, and only the confirmation's 删除 calls the host.

| Control | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Namespace | `mcp__<serverName>__*`, with tags for status, transport, and tool count |
| Target | the `command …args` line, or the endpoint URL |
| Switch | writes the row's `disabled` flag in the profile patch, exactly as the deployment's own plugin list does |
| 详情 | entry id, plugin, transport, redacted configuration, every registered tool, then 打开目录, 编辑, and 删除 |
| 新建服务器 | replaces the list with a create form, so the empty state and the form never share the view |
| 删除 | removes the row from the profile patch, then waits for the Loader to drop it |

A fixed two-column grid: server name and transport share the first row, then the
transport's own fields — command and working directory, or a URL spanning both
columns — and arguments and environment variables side by side at three rows each.
Everything not needed for the common case (timeout, fail-on-startup) sits behind
one **更多选项** disclosure.

Format guidance lives in the controls' placeholders, never as prose under them, so
no field grows a second line and the columns stay aligned. The form replaces the
list while it is open, so the header cannot offer a button the form already is.
Editing loads the deployment's own form projection on demand, which is the only
per-item read the page performs besides a skill's full body.

**打开目录** reveals a skill's own folder, or the profile directory holding
`cordis.patch.yml` for an MCP row. It reuses the deployment's own capability rather
than re-implementing platform launching: the page asks `GET /open-in-app/apps`
which file-manager entry this host resolved (`explorer`, `finder`, or
`filemanager`) and posts `{app, path}` to `POST /open-in-app/open`. When the
catalog resolves no file manager — an SSH launch, for example — the control is not
offered at all.

The directory always comes from the host payload, and the host derives it with
`dirname` from a path it already resolved. The page never invents the path.

Nothing polls, and there is no refresh button. The list is read on mount — which
happens every time the panel is opened — again when the window regains focus
(throttled to one read per four seconds), and after every write the page performs.
The controls that mutate anything re-read the list themselves, so the page never
shows a state the deployment has already left.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-this-directory>
```

or, from an Agent session, `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle` and the
absolute path of this directory as the target.

**A host-code change needs a process restart.** The deployment composes the browser
half from `dsh.client` and hot-reloads its bundle, so a page refresh is enough for
UI changes; the Node half is imported once into the process's ESM cache, so a new
`lib/index.js` takes effect only after the application restarts.

This repository is the plugin's home; npm is an optional second channel.
`npm run publish:npm` handles it, and it exists because two things about this name
are easy to get wrong.

**The bare name is taken.** `dsh-skill-mcp-panel` on npm belongs to an unrelated
DSH plugin — [Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel](https://github.com/Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel),
which covers the same ground with more features and is actively maintained. An
unscoped publish fails with a 403, and adding a confusingly similar neighbour would
be worse than not publishing at all. So the script publishes under the scope of
whoever is logged in, which cannot collide with anyone.

**A mirror cannot accept a publish.** A `registry=` line in `~/.npmrc` is often a
read-only mirror, so the script always targets `registry.npmjs.org` explicitly.

```bash
npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/   # once; a website login does not count
npm run publish:npm
```

Signing in at npmjs.com is not the same as signing in the CLI: npm keeps the
browser session and the command line separate, and a token has to land in
`~/.npmrc`. The script says exactly this if it finds no token.

The package name is swapped in for the duration of the publish and restored
afterwards — even when the publish fails — so the repository keeps its own name.
`prepublishOnly` runs the test suite as a gate, and the version has to be bumped
(`npm version patch`) before publishing again.

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and the `dsh.client` browser half |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The bundle patch that inserts the Node half into a profile |
| `lib/index.js` | Node half: the `/skill-mcp` read/write surface |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the `sidebar.panellist` entry and the `main` page |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | Node-half tests over a fake host, validating writes as real YAML |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | Browser-half render tests over a minimal hook-aware renderer |

There is no build step. `lib/` is the authored source and the shipped artifact, and
the browser half is hand-authored in the module-table format
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), so no bundler is required and
pnpm never has to run a dependency build script. There are no runtime
dependencies.

```bash
npm test
```

Node's built-in test runner, 83 tests, no dependencies. The host suite drives the
real route handler over a fake host context whose config editor parses the profile
patch with a real YAML reader, so every emitted document is validated by a parser
other than the writer that produced it. The client suite renders the browser half
through a minimal hook-aware renderer and asserts on the resulting tree.

If no YAML reader is installed anywhere, the host suite still runs; it just stops
checking emitted documents with an independent parser. Point `DSH_YAML_MODULE` at
one to restore that layer.

Everything lives under one prefix route. Every request first passes the
deployment's own trust fence, `ctx.connection.requestRejection()` — the same
Host/Origin and browser-authentication check every shipped host route uses
(`/open-in-app` included). A composition without a connection service falls back
to a `Sec-Fetch-Site`/`Origin` check.

| Route | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/skill-mcp/state` | GET | the merged snapshot; `?bodies=0` skips body previews, `?session=<id>` scopes the skill read |
| `/skill-mcp/skill` | GET | one skill's full definition, used only to enrich its body |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/enabled` | POST | `{ name, enabled }` — writes the enablement overlay |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/delete` | POST | `{ name }` — deletes a skill the user owns, or parks a shipped one |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/restore` | POST | `{ trashId }` — puts a parked skill back |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/server` | GET | one server's form projection, loaded on demand by the edit form |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/save` | POST | `{ entryId, config }` — persists through `ctx.configEditor.edit()` |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/create` | POST | `{ config }` — appends a row to the profile patch |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/enabled` | POST | `{ entryId, enabled }` — writes the row's `disabled` flag |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/delete` | POST | `{ entryId }` — removes the row from the profile patch |

Only the detail view's body enrichment and the edit form use a per-item route; the
list payload already carries everything else, so expanding a row can never show an
empty panel.

The Node half requires `webServer`, `connection`, `skills`, and `tools`, and reads
the optional `agents`, `agentPresets`, `configEditor`, and `hmr` services through
`ctx.get(...)`. The skill read resolves its scope in this order: a session named by
`?session=`, the newest live root Agent (with its workspace `cwd`), the default
Agent preset's standing scope, then the global layer alone; the resolved source is
reported as `skills.scopeSource`.

- **Configuration edits** go through `ctx.configEditor.edit()`, which validates the
  next value against the running plugin, reconciles the Loader, and rolls back on
  failure.
- **Row creation, the `disabled` flag, and row removal** are text patches of the
  profile's own patch file, serialized through `ctx.hmr.runExclusive` and written
  atomically. The Loader is then polled: if the row does not mount, the flag does
  not apply, or a removed row stays mounted, within six seconds the previous file
  bytes are restored and the call fails with the reason.
- **Skill enablement** writes only this plugin's own overlay document and
  invalidates the registry's catalog cache. No skill file is edited.
- **Skill removal** never follows a path the page supplied; the host resolves the
  skill, derives the target with its own rules, and validates a trash id as a
  single path segment.
- **Credentials never reach the browser.** The list and detail payloads replace
  every credential-shaped value with a keep marker; the form shows those fields
  blank and saving a blank marker restores the stored value. A brand-new server has
  nothing to restore, so a blank credential field is simply dropped.
MIT

readme.section: dsh-skill-mcp-panel · 技能与 MCP 面板
readme.text:
> **DeepSeek Harness** 的技能列表与 MCP 服务器管理面板，挂在侧边栏，主题完全继承宿主自身的
> 设计 token。

[](./LICENSE)
[](#测试)
[](#目录结构)

[English](./README.md)

侧边栏一个入口——**技能与 MCP**——打开一整页，里面是两个紧凑列表：当前部署对外提供的全部
Agent 技能，以及全部已配置的 MCP 服务器。每行只有一行：名字、一句说明、一个开关，以及原地
展开的 **详情**。MCP 行还能编辑、新建、删除；两个列表都能打开该对象所在的目录。

页面里**没有自己的主题代码**。所有颜色、圆角、字体、焦点环都取自宿主的 `--dsw-*` token，
字号也跟随宿主，所以它会自动跟着部署主题（浅色／深色／第三方主题）以及
设置 → 外观 → **字号大小** 走。

`dsh-client-ui-layout` 把正文字号作为内联变量写到 `body` 上，并由它派生出一个增量：

```css
--dsh-content-font-size: 14px;                      /* 12–17，就是用户设置的那个值 */
--dsh-content-font-delta: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size, 14px) - 14px);
```

本页每一个尺寸都按会话区自己的写法表达——`<基准>px + var(--smp-delta)`，其中 `--smp-delta`
是 `--dsh-content-font-delta` 的别名。**没有任何写死的 px**，并且有测试守着这一点，所以面板
会和旁边的对话正文一起长缩。

当前会话构成下可见的技能目录，所以项目级和 preset 级的技能会和内置技能并列出现。

| 控件 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 名字 | `/名字` 标识 ＋ 发现来源；调用策略**只在非默认时才加标签** |
| 说明 | 截断到一行，完整文本留在 tooltip |
| 开关 | 启用／停用该技能 |
| 详情 | provider、来源、路径、用完整句子写清的调用策略、完整正文，以及 打开目录 / 删除 |

技能的调用策略由两个互相独立的标记决定，默认都开：

| 标记 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `modelInvocable` | 技能在**模型的技能目录**里，Agent 可以自己决定加载 |
| `userInvocable` | 技能在输入框的 **`/` 菜单**里，你可以打 `/名字` 手动调用 |

因为几乎所有技能两个都是开的，到处打标签等于没信息。所以行内只标非默认的情况，详情面板则用
一整句话说明，而不是丢两个词让你猜。

"停用"由本插件维护，**不是去改文件**。DSH 没有 per-skill 开关：技能存在是因为某个 provider
列出了它，而调用策略由 provider 自己决定——官方 Office provider 把两个标记**硬编码**了、
根本不读 frontmatter，所以改文件对它永远无效。

对所有 provider 都有效的杠杆是 registry 自己的去重规则：**同一层内，`rank` 最小的候选赢下这个
名字**。所以本插件注册一个 provider，把每个被停用的技能用 `rank: 0`、
`invocation: { modelInvocable: false, userInvocable: false }` 重新声明一遍。这样它会从模型目录
和 `/` 菜单里消失，但在本页面仍然可见——连同原来的说明、provider 和正文——随时可以开回来。

集合存在一个 JSON 文件里：`<DSH 目录>/storages/skill-mcp-panel.json`，每次变更都会让 registry
的目录缓存失效。

**删除**是真的删文件，不是另一种"停用"。目录型技能删的是整个 `<根>/<名字>/` 目录，所以它的
`references/`、`scripts/` 一起走；其它情况只删那一个文件。确认框会在**动手之前**告诉你会走哪种
模式。

| 技能来源 | 模式 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 你自己的——`project-dsh`、`project-agents`、`user-dsh`、`user-agents`、`custom` | **永久删除** | 直接删掉，什么都不留 |
| 官方／包内的——`bundled` 及其它 | **移入回收站** | 文件离开原目录，但被移到回收站并列在 **已删除** 里，点 **恢复** 放回原位 |

这个区分依据 registry 自带的 `source` 字段——它本来就记录了谁拥有这个文件。你自己的技能是你的，
删就删。官方技能不一样：删了会毁掉升级自带的文件，而且重装时会被悄悄还原；何况开关对 Office
技能本来就无解。把这一类存起来，能让唯一有效的杠杆保持可逆。

被移走的技能落在 `<DSH 目录>/storages/skill-mcp-panel.trash/<id>/`，带一个记着原路径的
`manifest.json`。恢复时会拒绝覆盖已经重新出现的路径；trash id 会被校验成单个路径段，所以回收站
之外的东西都寻址不到。

删除永远是两步：操作行被替换成一个写着技能名的确认块，只有确认块里的"删除"才会请求宿主。

每个已配置的服务器一行。

| 控件 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 命名空间 | `mcp__<serverName>__*`，附状态、传输、工具数量的标签 |
| 目标 | `命令 …参数` 那一行，或端点 URL |
| 开关 | 写 profile patch 里这一行的 `disabled`，和部署自己的插件列表完全一致 |
| 详情 | entry id、插件名、传输、脱敏后的配置、全部已注册工具，然后是 打开目录、编辑、删除 |
| 新建服务器 | 用新建表单替换列表，所以空状态和表单永远不会同时出现 |
| 删除 | 从 profile patch 移除这一行，然后等 Loader 真的卸载 |

固定两列网格：服务器名和传输占第一行，然后是传输自己的字段——命令和工作目录，或者跨两列的
地址——参数和环境变量并排、各三行。常见情况下用不到的东西（超时、启动失败即报错）收在一个
**更多选项** 折叠里。

格式提示只放在控件的 placeholder 里，绝不写成控件下面的说明文字，所以没有字段会长出第二行，
列也始终对齐。表单打开时会替换列表，这样标题栏就不可能提供一个"它自己就是"的按钮。编辑时才按需
读取部署自己的表单投影，这是本页除技能正文之外唯一的单项读取。

**打开目录**会揭开技能自己的目录，或 MCP 行所在的、装着 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 profile 目录。
它复用部署自身的能力，而不是重新实现平台启动：页面先问 `GET /open-in-app/apps` 这台宿主解析出
的是哪个文件管理器（`explorer`、`finder`、`filemanager`），再向 `POST /open-in-app/open` 发
`{app, path}`。当目录里解析不到文件管理器时——比如通过 SSH 启动——这个控件干脆不出现。

目录永远来自宿主返回的 payload，宿主用 `dirname` 从自己已经解析过的路径推导。页面从不自己编路径。

没有任何轮询，也没有刷新按钮。列表在挂载时读一次（每次打开面板都会挂载），窗口重新获得焦点时
再读一次（节流到每四秒最多一次），以及页面自己每次写入之后再读一次。所有会改动的控件都会自己
重读列表，所以页面永远不会展示一个部署已经离开的状态。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录路径>
```

或者在 Agent 会话里用 `plugin_manager`，`action: install_bundle`，target 用本目录的绝对路径。

**改宿主代码需要重启进程。** 部署从 `dsh.client` 组合浏览器半边并热重载它的 bundle，所以 UI
改动刷新页面即可；而 Node 半边只被 import 进进程的 ESM 缓存一次，新的 `lib/index.js` 只有在应用
重启后才生效。

本仓库是这个插件的家；npm 是可选的第二个分发渠道。发布用 `npm run publish:npm`，之所以要专门
写个脚本，是因为这个名字有两件事很容易搞错。

**裸名字已经被占了。** npm 上的 `dsh-skill-mcp-panel` 属于另一个**无关**的 DSH 插件——
[Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel](https://github.com/Fishquito7/dsh-skill-mcp-panel)，它做的事
基本一样、功能更多，而且还在活跃维护。不带 scope 发布会被 403 拒掉；而另起一个相近到让人混淆的
名字，比不发还糟。所以脚本用**当前登录者自己的 scope** 发布，这样任何人都撞不到。

**镜像不能接受发布。** `~/.npmrc` 里的 `registry=` 常常是只读镜像，所以脚本永远显式打到
`registry.npmjs.org`。

```bash
npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/   # 只需一次；网站登录不算
npm run publish:npm
```

在 npmjs.com 网站登录和命令行登录**不是一回事**：npm 把浏览器会话和命令行分开，token 必须落到
`~/.npmrc` 里。脚本发现没有 token 时会直接把这一点打印出来。

包名只在发布期间被替换，发布结束后会被还原——即使发布失败也还原——所以仓库始终保留自己的名字。
`prepublishOnly` 会跑测试作为门禁；再次发布前需要先升版本（`npm version patch`）。

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client` 浏览器半边 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把 Node 半边插进 profile 的 bundle patch |
| `lib/index.js` | Node 半边：`/skill-mcp` 读写接口 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：`sidebar.panellist` 入口和 `main` 页面 |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | Node 半边测试，跑在假宿主上，用真实 YAML 校验写入 |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 浏览器半边渲染测试，跑在一个极小的、懂 hook 的渲染器上 |

**没有构建步骤。** `lib/` 既是源代码也是发布产物；浏览器半边是用模块表格式
（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`）手写的，所以不需要打包器，pnpm 也不用跑任何
依赖构建脚本。**运行时零依赖。**

```bash
npm test
```

Node 自带测试运行器，83 个测试，零依赖。宿主套件在假宿主上下文上跑真实的 route handler，而这个
假宿主的 config editor 用一个**真实的 YAML 解析器**去解析 profile patch——所以每个产出的文档都是
被"写它的代码之外"的解析器校验过的。渲染套件用一个极小的、懂 hook 的渲染器渲染浏览器半边，并对
渲染结果断言。

如果机器上没有任何 YAML 解析器，宿主套件照样能跑，只是不再用独立解析器校验产出文档。可以用
`DSH_YAML_MODULE` 指向一个来恢复这层校验。

所有接口都在一个前缀路由下。每个请求先过部署自己的信任闸门
`ctx.connection.requestRejection()`——和每一个官方宿主路由（包括 `/open-in-app`）用的是同一套
Host/Origin 加浏览器身份校验。没有 connection 服务的组合会退回到
`Sec-Fetch-Site`/`Origin` 检查。

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `/skill-mcp/state` | GET | 合并快照；`?bodies=0` 跳过正文预览，`?session=<id>` 指定技能读取的作用域 |
| `/skill-mcp/skill` | GET | 单个技能的完整定义，只用来补全正文 |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/enabled` | POST | `{ name, enabled }`——写启用状态 overlay |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/delete` | POST | `{ name }`——永久删除自己的技能，或把官方技能移入回收站 |
| `/skill-mcp/skill/restore` | POST | `{ trashId }`——把移入回收站的技能放回去 |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/server` | GET | 单个服务器的表单投影，由编辑表单按需读取 |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/save` | POST | `{ entryId, config }`——经 `ctx.configEditor.edit()` 持久化 |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/create` | POST | `{ config }`——向 profile patch 追加一行 |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/enabled` | POST | `{ entryId, enabled }`——写这一行的 `disabled` |
| `/skill-mcp/mcp/delete` | POST | `{ entryId }`——从 profile patch 移除这一行 |

只有详情页的正文补全和编辑表单走单项路由；列表 payload 已经带了其它一切，所以展开一行永远不可能
出现空面板。

Node 半边要求 `webServer`、`connection`、`skills`、`tools`，并通过 `ctx.get(...)` 读取可选的
`agents`、`agentPresets`、`configEditor`、`hmr`。技能读取的作用域按以下顺序解析：`?session=` 指定
的会话、最新的存活根 Agent（带它的工作区 `cwd`）、默认 Agent preset 的常驻作用域、最后只有全局层；
解析结果由 `skills.scopeSource` 报告。

- **配置编辑**走 `ctx.configEditor.edit()`：它会拿运行中的插件校验新值、调和 Loader，失败时回滚。
- **新建行、`disabled` 标记、删除行**都是对 profile 自己的 patch 文件做文本补丁，经
  `ctx.hmr.runExclusive` 串行化并原子写入。然后轮询 Loader：如果这一行六秒内没有挂载、标记没有
  生效、或者删掉的行仍然挂着，就把先前的文件内容还原，并带着原因失败。
- **技能启用状态**只写本插件自己的 overlay 文档，并让 registry 的目录缓存失效。**不改任何技能文件。**
- **技能删除**绝不跟随页面给的路径；由宿主自己解析技能、用自己的规则推导目标，并把 trash id 校验
  成单个路径段。
- **凭据永不进入浏览器。** 列表和详情 payload 会把所有形如凭据的值替换成 keep 标记；表单把这些字段
  显示为空，保存空标记会还原已存储的值。全新的服务器没有东西可还原，所以空的凭据字段会被直接丢掉。
